frontmatter.sok_read_scope: Supplied summary of Stop and review-and-trust-hooks sections

documents.body:
# Published protocol

Stop input includes turn_id:string, stop_hook_active:boolean and
last_assistant_message:string|null; matcher is unused.
Nonempty exit-0 stdout must be JSON. {"decision":"block","reason":"..."} requests
continuation using that reason as a new user prompt; it does not hide or reject
the displayed turn. Exit 2 with stderr reason is an alternative.

documents.body:
# Claims and limits

Stop requests another turn; nonmanaged trust binds an exact definition.
Correction of either upstream rule reverses its corresponding claim.
No minimum version or active-client trust is established.
Active-flag loop guards, one-pass limits and formatting policies are consumer
choices, not vendor requirements.

frontmatter.title: Codex Stop continuation and hook trust — sok
frontmatter.description: Published continuation semantics and definition-specific trust

documents.body:
# Question

How do Stop continuation and hook trust interact?

Continuation preserves displayed output. Nonmanaged user, project and plugin
hooks require review and trust of the exact definition hash; new or changed
definitions are skipped until trusted through hook review. Managed policy is
separate. Configuration presence does not establish execution.
